description: What a Line on security.osv-unkeyed needs: the page of the OSV match document's advisories with no CVE alias it posts. One run posts at most 1,000 inbox items, so the pairs are numbered in pages of 1,000 and each page has its own Line.

page.description: The page this Line posts (1 for the first thousand pairs in component then advisory order, 2 for the next, ...; page 20 holds the rest).

name: security.osv-unkeyed.params
